about: Pirate havens (the Ledger topic 'Trade', your answer 'Pirate havens that raid shipping and coasts until suppressed'). Each raids sea trade and coasts within reach_km of its haven from 'from' until history's suppression ('until'), unless a realm suppresses it sooner: by holding the haven, or by keeping warships there for six months. Sources: Polybius 2.8-12 (the Illyrians of Teuta; Rome's wars of 229 and 219 BC; their end in 168 BC, Livy 45.26); Plutarch, Pompey 24-28 and Appian, Mithridatic Wars 92-96 (the Cilician pirates, swept from the sea by Pompey in 67 BC); Diodorus 40.1 and Velleius 2.34 (Crete, conquered by Metellus 69-67 BC); the Barbary corsairs of Algiers, Tunis and Tripoli (about 1500 to the French taking of Algiers in 1830). Our own data, free for any use.
